Mini-Epaper-S3 enclosure and Pager enclosures are different devices. The two watch_strap_hook files are strap accessories only and do not establish an Ultra watch-body assembly.
The A7608 ESP32 layout is a DXF drawing. Available STEP boards are A7670X, SIM7600 or S3 SIM7670 variants; substituting them would infer connector, module and battery-holder geometry.

The older SIM800 repository offers two unnamed printed parts, while the multi-modem tree supplies 2D outlines and other modem boards. Mechanical compatibility of those unnamed parts with selected T-Call V1.4 has not been established.
The linked SIM7000G STEP and shell are specifically named for SIM7000G. Selected modem/board revisions are not proven to share that assembly; the exact listing photographs remain the preview basis.

The inspected style2/full.stp is a 13-component 74.730 × 125.641 × 13.172 mm enclosure assembly from the EPD47 repository. The source does not establish selected ESP32-S3 V2.3 compatibility, so original-classic or other style enclosures are not promoted to exact CAD.

The downloaded 0-all_asm.stp has four enclosure components (41.143 × 139.241 × 31.600 mm); the tree also names an A76XX assembly. Exact selected SIM7080-S3 board/connector fit is unverified, so these files remain candidates.
The available T5-series STEP is explicitly 2.13-inch. It is not an exact mechanical reference for the 2.7-inch T5S assembly.
All four .obj/.OBJ candidates were downloaded and inspected: they are compiled Keil C51 program objects, not Wavefront vertex/face meshes. No geometry is derived from these binary compiler outputs.
The .kicad_mod candidates are sensor PCB footprints. They do not supply a full board, display or enclosure 3D assembly.
The .kicad_mod candidates are sensor PCB footprints. They do not supply a full board, display or enclosure 3D assembly.
The USB-3.0-TYPE-A-TF.kicad_mod candidate is a PCB footprint, not a complete T-Dongle-S3 model.
The linked T-Embed enclosure predates the separately selected SI4732 device; radio controls, connectors and mechanical compatibility are not established for this variant.
The CC1101 STEP assemblies are for the earlier board/enclosure. Exact Plus mechanical revision and port/control compatibility have not been established.
The sole structure/T-Energy-S3.dxf candidate is a 2D drawing; it does not encode a 3D enclosure/PCB assembly.
The FB126 gai/huan files describe cover/ring components for an optional wearable assembly. They are not established as the stock T-QT-C6 board or supplied cuboid enclosure.

The downloaded 2.1-inch STEP has a 61.476 × 59.500 × 18.300 mm envelope and a flattened display edge. The selected Full Circle/CST820 listing photograph explicitly labels a 75 mm circular cover; the FT3267 version is 63 mm. File naming alone does not prove the CAD matches Full Circle, and it is not scaled to force agreement.
Both T-TWR STEP files are explicitly Plus display-shell variants. They are not assigned to the selected original Rev1.x board.
The candidate is T7-C6_V1.0.step from a linked sibling repository. T7-C6 is neither the C5 chip nor the Dongle form factor.
The generic old TWatch-Library manifold STL names do not establish S3 or S3 Plus mechanical revision, button or connector fit.
The generic old TWatch-Library manifold STL names do not establish S3 or S3 Plus mechanical revision, button or connector fit.

3D_Motor.stl is a 29.5 × 30 × 33.046 mm motor/pump accessory shape, not the soil-sensor board. prt0001.rar was opened and three STL members inspected; complete board/enclosure fit for the selected HiGrow revision remains unverified.
